basis: Declared UI benchmark matrices (audit #30). The canonical version keeps the 29-take matrix every published record measured: one cold medium take for Custom and Design, then three warm repetitions per mode and length. Other versions reallocate warm repetitions per mode and length; scripts/ui_test.sh <platform> benchmark --matrix-version NAME runs one, and its records are focused (never canonical) until the maintainer makes it canonicalVersion. scripts/ui_bench_allocation.py derive RECORD... computes an allocation from measured per-cell spread and per-take cost (minimax standard error under the canonical matrix's own time budget) and --write NAME adds it here as derived.

uniform-v1.description: Three warm repetitions per mode and length plus one cold medium take for Custom and Design: 29 takes.

proposal-5-3-2.description: Audit #30's proposed per-mode split, five short, three medium and two long warm takes: 30 warm plus 2 cold = 32 takes. Not derived from measured spread; the lead's re-measure run replaces it with a derived version.
